name: Visual Studio Code
description: Find your way around VS Code: folders, the Command Palette, search, the terminal, extensions and Git commits.
notes: Electron app. Chromium exposes the workbench to UI Automation once accessibility is active; VS Code detects screen readers automatically, and editor.accessibilitySupport set to on forces the optimized mode. Activity Bar items carry their shortcut in the accessible name, such as Explorer (Ctrl+Shift+E), so checks match on name prefixes where possible. Default keybindings shown are for Windows with a US layout.
